article.headline: ‘Wheel of Fortune’ Announcer Jim Thornton Fired by Sony
article.summary: “Wheel of Fortune” announcer Jim Thornton has been fired from the game show, Sony Pictures TV confirmed. “Following a thorough investigation, Jim Thornton’s employment with ‘Wheel of Fortune’ has been terminated, effective immediately,” the studio said in a statement.
